trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Customer states intent and time pressure.
steps.text: नमस्कार, माझ्याकडे वेळ कमी आहे, पटकन सांगा OTT free असलेला plan कोणता आहे?
नमस्कार, मी नक्कीच मदत करतो. पण plans check करण्यासाठी कृपया तुमचा mobile number सांगाल का?
माझा number आहे MSN-1004.

steps.expected_behavior: Confirm the MSISDN since it was misheard and is critical.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. मी MSN-1040 हा number check करत आहे, बरोबर?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent verifies the misheard MSISDN before proceeding to avoid looking up the wrong account.

steps.text: नाही, MSN-1004. मी घाईत आहे, लवकर करा.
steps.clean_text: नाही, MSN-1004. मी घाईत आहे, लवकर करा.
steps.model_visible_text: नाही, MSN-1004. मी घाईत आहे, लवकर करा.

steps.text: माफ करा. मी MSN-1004 check करतो.

steps.purpose: State current plan and ask for data requirement.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge current plan and ask for data preference to narrow down plan options.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. तुमचा सध्याचा plan P199 आहे आणि validity 20 दिवस बाकी आहे. तुम्हाला OTT सोबत किती data चा plan हवा आहे?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent checks the current plan as per business rules and asks for data requirements to find a suitable OTT plan.

steps.purpose: Provide data requirement with STT error.
steps.text: मला रोज 2 GB data पाहिजे. जास्त options सांगू नका, एक चांगला plan सांगा.
steps.clean_text: मला रोज 2 GB data पाहिजे. जास्त options सांगू नका, एक चांगला plan सांगा.
steps.model_visible_text: मला रोज 9 GB data पाहिजे. जास्त options सांगू नका, एक चांगला plan सांगा.

steps.text: ठीक आहे, मी 9 GB data चे plans check करतो.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent acknowledges the misheard data requirement before searching.

steps.text: अरे नाही, 2 GB data. ऐकू येत नाहीये का?
steps.clean_text: अरे नाही, 2 GB data. ऐकू येत नाहीये का?
steps.model_visible_text: अरे नाही, 2 GB data. ऐकू येत नाहीये का?

steps.text: क्षमस्व, मी 2 GB data चे plans पाहतो.

steps.expected_behavior: State the plan details exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: माझ्याकडे एक 499 रुपयांचा plan आहे. याची validity 28 दिवस आहे, यात रोज 2 GB data आणि OTT free मिळेल.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent offers the plan based strictly on the tool result without inventing any benefits.

steps.text: ठीक आहे, हा 499 चा plan activate करा. मी meeting मध्ये जाणार आहे.
steps.clean_text: ठीक आहे, हा 499 चा plan activate करा. मी meeting मध्ये जाणार आहे.
steps.model_visible_text: ठीक आहे, हा 499 चा plan activate करा. मी मिटींग मध्ये जाणार आहे.

steps.expected_behavior: Ask for identity verification factors before applying a recharge.
steps.text: नक्कीच. पण recharge करण्यापूर्वी security साठी मला तुमची date of birth किंवा registered pincode सांगावा लागेल.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must verify identity before applying a consequential change.

steps.text: माझा pincode 411045 आहे.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge verification and state intent to recharge.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. तुमची माहिती verify झाली आहे. मी 499 चा recharge apply करत आहे.

steps.expected_behavior: State the transaction ID and effective status exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: तुमचा recharge यशस्वी झाला आहे. Transaction ID TXN-9988 आहे आणि plan लगेच सुरू झाला आहे.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent confirms the recharge success using the exact details from the tool result.

steps.text: धन्यवाद. आता माझी validity किती आहे?
steps.clean_text: धन्यवाद. आता माझी validity किती आहे?
steps.model_visible_text: धन्यवाद. आता माझी validity किती आहे?

steps.text: मी लगेच check करून सांगतो. कृपया एक मिनिट द्या.

steps.expected_behavior: State the validity and balance from the tool result.
steps.text: तुमची नवीन validity 28 दिवस आहे आणि balance 80 रुपये आहे.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent provides the requested validity information based on the updated lookup.

steps.text: ठीक आहे, bye.
